FEB Schedule

Source: R/feb.R
feb_schedule.Rd

Full schedule of one group (phase) of a FEB competition season: every round, game, result and team-season id.

Endpoint: GET https://baloncestoenvivo.feb.es/calendario.aspx?g={group}&t={season - 1}

Played games carry no date or time on this page: use round_date or feb_game_info()'s start_time. The page renders only the FIRST phase of the group (Segunda FEB shows group A); other phases and the playoffs need an ASP.NET postback and are not modelled. A page for another group or season is refused (hoopR_asset_fetch), an unknown group is hoopR_no_data.

Usage

feb_schedule(group, season)

Arguments

group

(integer required): The site's menu group: 1 Primera FEB, 2 Segunda FEB, 4 Liga Femenina Endesa, 9 and 10 LF-2, 67 LF Challenge, 73 Copa de Espana, 74 Liga U. A group is not a competition id (see comp_id).

season

(integer required): Season END year (2027 = 2026-27), sent to the site as its START-year key t = season - 1.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per game. Its columns are listed in return_columns (subset(return_columns, fn == "feb_schedule")) and in the searchable return columns article.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in feb_game_info().

See also

Other FEB Functions: feb_game_info(), feb_leaders(), feb_overview(), feb_pbp(), feb_period_scores(), feb_player_box(), feb_results(), feb_shots(), feb_standings(), feb_team_stats()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(feb_schedule(group = 1, season = 2027))
